Monitor planned vs. actual progress, critical path, milestones and schedule performance. Prepare weekly/monthly project controls reports, dashboards, S-curves and management reports. Manage project cost, commitments, actuals, forecasts and Estimate at Completion (EAC). Implement Earned Value Management and monitor SPI, CPI, PV, EV and AC. Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Construction, T&C, Commercial, Finance and subcontractor teams. Monitor manpower, resources, productivity and subcontractor performance. Maintain project risk, change, variation and delay registers. Identify schedule/cost deviations and develop recovery and mitigation plans. Support delay analysis, variation, claims and extension-of-time assessments. Ensure accurate physical progress measurement and alignment between schedule and cost. Maintain project control procedures, records and approved baseline/change history. Provide timely and accurate project performance information to project management. Ensure compliance with company and contractual project reporting requirements.
